## Why read science?

- **Information:** reading science helps identify and verify knowledge that can be used in professional work and day-day decision-making; valuable skill for anyone <br><br>
- **Inspiration:** reading science helps identify and verify *techniques and methods* that can be used to explore new questions; valuable skill for scientists (and aspiring scientists)<br><br>
- **Entertainment/wonder:** reading science can provide an additional source of intrigue/curiosity about the world

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
